scopeLabel: All 9 main and 5 SI pages read in text and actual page images. Three CdS liquid–gas synthesis temperatures, gas generation, TiO2/FTO support preparation, three CdS sensitizations, three CdSe co-sensitizations, separately qualified ZnS passivation, electrolyte and cathode support, and six photovoltaic devices. Measurement contexts preserve source sample labels but do not invent exact physical batch identity. Source ambiguities and incomplete protocols remain explicit. No external cited procedure is reconstructed.

availability.morphology_illustration: Three qualified TEM outline schematics; all other contexts remain nongeometric. Optional bulk CdS cells are independent references only for powder XRD contexts.

bindings.caption: Dissolve cadmium nitrate in 15 mL oleylamine at 140 °C. Three-neck flask. Clear solution is the reported complex-formation endpoint; heating duration and exact dissolved complex are not given. Main PDF p.2 §2.1 prints 1 mM of cadmium nitrate is taken. Concentration is written as an amount; total moles/mass and hydration state are unresolved. No correction to 1 mmol. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Raise reaction temperature to 160 °C. As soon as the selected reaction temperature is reached, begin H2S introduction. No ramp rate or stabilization dwell supplied. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Pass H2S for 10 min at 160 °C. H2S feed begins at target temperature. Gas flow and delivered amount are not reported; kinetic discussion does not define a separate measured nucleation duration. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Stop reaction by removing flask from heating mantle. Physical removal from mantle is the reported termination. No quench solvent or cooling bath invented. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.
Cool to 100 °C. Cooling method and rate are unreported. Workup atmosphere not separately restated. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Add chloroform after cooling to 100 °C. Requisite amount of chloroform to remove unreacted oleylamine; quantity unreported. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.
Add ethanol to precipitate yellow product. Add ethanol to precipitate yellow product Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Centrifuge five times at 6000 rpm for 5 min each. Recover yellow powder/precipitated solids. Between-cycle wash and redispersion details are not stated. No rotor-radius-to-RCF conversion. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.
Dry cleaned powder under vacuum at 70 °C. Drying time and vacuum pressure are not reported. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Acquire TEM, HRTEM and SAED. JEOL200kV FETEM; Digital Micrograph. Grid preparation, dilution and dose unreported. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Grind powder and load grooved quartz-glass plate. Well-ground powder loaded for Bragg–Brentano geometry; sample mass and grinding method unreported. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Acquire laboratory powder XRD. Philips X Pert Pro CuKα. Angular units are not silently added to the printed step and rate. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Acquire synchrotron powder XRD. BL18B Indian beamline at Photon Factory KEK; Bragg–Brentano geometry. Dwell adjusted for signal-to-noise, no numeric dwell. Main PDF p.2 §2.2 states 14 keV and λ=1.0287 Å; Figure2 also states λ=1.0287 Å. These are inconsistent energy/wavelength values, retained without choosing a replacement. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Acquire powder absorption and PL spectra. Lambda35 UV–vis and PerkinElmer LS55 PL. Source does not give a universal excitation wavelength or powder optical specimen preparation. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
